findings.evidence: `Map.lean:123-127` and `Map.lean:144-148` have RHS `⟦GenLoop.const⟧`; `Map.lean:154-165` and `225-234` normalize positive-dimensional constant maps/homs to `1`; grep finds no `mk_const_eq_one`, and Mathlib only has untagged `HomotopyGroup.one_def` at `mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Homotopy/HomotopyGroup.lean:579`.
findings.fix: Add a public positive-dimensional bridge such as `@[simp] theorem mk_const_eq_one [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] : (⟦(GenLoop.const : Ω^ N X x)⟧ : HomotopyGroup N X x) = 1 := HomotopyGroup.one_def.symm`, then keep the dimension-general lemmas for dimension zero.
findings.issue: `map_continuousMap_const_apply` and `map_apply_of_subsingleton` rewrite to `⟦GenLoop.const⟧`, while the positive-dimensional API also exposes `map_*_eq_one` and `mapHom_* = 1`; there is no local simp lemma normalizing `⟦GenLoop.const⟧` to `1`.

summary: The constant-map API still exposes two positive-dimensional normal forms without a public simp bridge from the quotient class of `GenLoop.const` back to `1`. This leaves the exported class-valued characteristic lemmas awkward for downstream positive-dimensional automation.
